ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) surface with approximately 20% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage concentrated in localized spots and trailing edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white mottling (high-intensity pixel blobs) concentrated in the mid-to-outer lobes. Solid high-intensity white banding present along the lateral tips of both lobes. Central region near the median notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of peaks is higher on the right lobe edge compared to the left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge sweeping upward from the median notch to the lateral tips; convex curvature along the lower leading edge (partially occluded by water).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (scars) distributed across both lobes, with higher density in the distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) detected on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white scarring and irregular pigmentation at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive barnacle scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast 'salt and pepper' appearance created by the sharp transition between dark base pigmentation and dense white scarring.
